Giver: Right, I'll guide you. Start at the cross, go up past the camera shop on the left.
Follower: Okay, going up past the camera shop.
Giver: Keep going up a bit more, then turn sharply left. Go all the way to the top edge of the map.
Follower: Turned left, heading to the top edge.
Giver: Now turn right and go straight down. Stop just past the parked van.
Follower: Straight down, past the van.
Giver: Turn left again. Go up towards the allotments.
Follower: Turning left, heading up toward the allotments.
Giver: Pass the allotments on your right, but don't touch them. Keep going up.
Follower: Okay, passing them on the right.
Giver: Turn left now. Go up to the level crossing.
Follower: Wait, I don't see a level crossing there.
Giver: Ah, look for the road crossing, sort of in the middle. Turn left there.
Follower: Okay, found a crossing. Turning left.
Giver: Go up past the crossing. Turn left again and go up towards the alpine garden.
Follower: Going up, passing the alpine garden on the right.
Giver: Good. Turn left now. Go up to the youth hostel.
Follower: Found the youth hostel. Turning left.
Giver: Pass the hostel on your right. Keep going up. Turn left at the telephone box.
Follower: Passing the hostel, found the telephone box. Turning left.
Giver: Go up past the telephone box. Turn left again.
Follower: Turning left.
Giver: Go up towards the thatched mud hut. Pass it on the right, then turn left.
Follower: Found the hut. Passing on the right, turning left.
Giver: Go up a bit. You should see a cross. That's the finish.
Follower: I see a cross! Is that it?
Giver: Yes, stop there. That's the finish.
Follower: Done.
Giver: Great job.
Follower: Thanks, bye.
